title: The Water Over the Seed Tray
youtube_title: The Water Over the Seed Tray | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Telling the truth early makes a small mistake easier to mend.
summary: At a ceramic studio sill above the quiet plaza, Chioma is tangled up with a seed tray watered so hard the soil swam and almost hides it. Chioma tells Grandpa Sol the plain truth, and together they mend what can be mended, with no teasing.
